scope: All low-order integer data of the full fibres in the frozen dense package. No integer relaxation is asserted sufficient for actual labels.
count_quadruple_note: This is an overinclusive finite rectangle of count slots, not a number of realizable models or a claim of separately enumerating each slot. The actual-label theorem uniformly excludes every slot and all degree/codegree refinements.
variables: lambda_j(D) for every j in {4,5,6,7} and every positional D subset of [21] with |D|<=4; d_j(x)=lambda_j({x}); lambda_j(empty)=Z_(21-j)
integrality: All lambda are nonnegative integers, bounded by binomial(21-|D|,j-|D|)
all_deletion_equations: For n=21-|D| and every r=0,...,n-17: binomial(n,r)+sum_{k=14}^17(-1)^k binomial(n-k,r)lambda_(21-k)(D)=0 mod5
block_conditions: Same-size distinct blocks intersect in at most j-2 positions. Distinct-size same-sum blocks cannot contain one another.
six_six_blocks: Fully eliminated: common core size3, six disjoint petals size3; induced lambda4 codegrees force total C4 degree270, not divisible by4.
realizability: A single actual 4x21 matrix over F5 with nonzero distinct columns; every fibre is the complete family defined by its column sums. All such matrices under this package are ruled out by the complete normalization and searches.
